preceding_paragraph: Table S10 | Recovery of simultaneous leaks with a resolvable-class dictionary. Leaks were placed at junctions in distinct classes of the 74-class dictionary (Supplementary Note 1.5) with discharges drawn uniformly between 5 and 20 L s⁻¹; component noise s.d. 0.02 m; 40 scenarios per case (seed 11), except the single-leak reference (60 scenarios). Class recall is the fraction of true leak classes contained in the estimated support when the number of leaks is supplied. Greedy is non-negative orthogonal matching pursuit; exhaustive evaluates all class pairs (2,701) or triples (64,824) by non-negative least-squares residual. The dictionary's mutual coherence is 0.9998. Fitted coefficients are not proportional to discharge and are not reported.
